endorsements.name: Kamil Szczurowski
endorsements.label: Hacking the Government: How Two Researchers Turned Late-Night Boredom Into a National Audit
endorsements.description: What happens when two researchers spend several days scrutinizing the Polish web? We didn’t just find anomalies—we took action. Join us as we reveal the results of our intensive research, which led to multiple official reports to CSIRT GOV, NASK, and MON. We will walk you through our findings, the scale of the threats discovered, and provide essential recommendations for a more secure digital future.
